actual_scope: Exact odd-denominator obstruction for the canonical four-qubit Clifford inverse at every odd f>=13 and every f=2 modulo 4 with f>=14.
scope_change_reason: The completed spectrum leaves the coefficient ring of a physical decoder unresolved. This result proves a necessary odd-division requirement and distinguishes canonical least squares from arbitrary left inverses.
bottleneck_link: An exact Gaussian-dyadic linear circuit cannot realize the full canonical decoder. Odd division, approximation or another recovery contract requires a separate price.
stop_rule: Stop after the two infinite-width valuation proofs, positive certificates and literal inverse controls. Do not build a physical decoder or cover f divisible by four.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the coefficient-ring theorem. RESULT.json gives exact valuations, interval certificates, finite width checks and a complete literal one-qubit inverse.
author: Ali Romman
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing
